text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This must be a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm part of the world of racing. I can run
with
everything I have! This happiness
feels
unreal—like an exquisite dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to live out this wonderful
dream and
enjoy it to the fullest. Once
it's over, I'll take the
abundant memories
I make here back home with
me as
souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day Fine Motion starts
training in
earnest for her debut in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Duly noted. ♪ I'll start running, then!
choice_data_list: まず今の能力を確認したい

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... ♪ One more lap! Hrraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she was born with innate talent.
Her
balanced physical strength and
powerful running
style are remarkable.
But more than anything...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew... ♪ That was delightful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The most enchanting thing about her is
the purity
with which she enjoys running.
That attitude will
no doubt become a
great asset for her. There's
just one
thing...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay for me to run one more
lap? I'm
still not satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What? But why? I can still keep going!
choice_data_list: いったん休憩にしよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to her "unique" circumstances, she's
never
trained as a runner before now.
Working too hard
off the bat will only
lead to injury.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But my legs are crying out! They wish to
run! I
implore you to reconsi—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion stumbles slightly and begins
to
stagger.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Captain...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume in a suit comes rushing
to Fine
Motion's aid. This is her
bodyguard.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I fear you may have injured yourself. I'll
arrange
for a complete medical
examination at once.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I assure you that I'm all right. I merely
stumbled.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Your Highness, but your
well-being is of
the utmost importance.
You are irreplaceable.
Your father has
made himself quite clear in this
regard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's house is descended from
royalty. In
present-day, they live in
Ireland, where her father
serves as a
high-ranked politician. Fine was
allowed
to study abroad on the condition of

staying absolutely safe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate your concern.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Were you also considering my position
when
making your remarks, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 立場じゃなくてレースのためだ
立場じゃなくてレースのためだよ

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: 無理をすればレースに出られない

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right. You're exactly right. I need
to enter
races!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I won't try to push myself
too hard
again! From now on, I'll do
what you tell me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So, Captain... I'd like you to have faith in
us as
you watch over me. I promise I will
never lose
sight of my circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of your astute wisdom,
Your
Highness. Please do take care of
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
One last thing. Could you spare some
time once
you've completed your
training? A certain
someone would like
to speak with you.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. It appears you're making great
strides.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Father!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dignified man displayed on the
computer
monitor is none other than
Fine Motion's father.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
I expect my official duties will make
opportunities
for us to converse like this
infrequent. As such, I
wished to speak
with you... and your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you are already well aware,
Fine has
responsibilities that prevent her
from doing as she
pleases.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
However, she has satisfactorily
demonstrated her
talent to me, and I
have in return granted her
three years in
which she can act freely.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
That being said, when our house arrived
in Ireland
all those years ago, we were
welcomed with
warmth and a new home.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, Trainer, I wish to
ask—are you
prepared to watch over and
guide my daughter?

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's father looks at me intently
with
eyes just like hers. Yet even in the
face of fatherly
apprehension, I stand
firm on my decision.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure you never forget those
words. Fine,
heed your trainer's
guidance, and run to your
heart's
content.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text: I'll be watching over you from afar.
choice_data_list: 彼女の夢を全力で支えます！

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that. And... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For joining me for some ramen! I ran so
much
during today's training that I'm
simply famished.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I almost forgot! Now that you have
my
father's blessing, I'd like to say this
again.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I expect great things from our
partnership these
next three years. I'm
looking forward to working
with you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know a great place nearby! They have
ramen
made with sardine stock...

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Unlike other Umamusume, Fine Motion
is
beginning her career with a strict time
limit in
place. All I can do is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up, Trainer! The ramen is
waiting! ♪

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is support her—someone
who smiles
joyously at something as
simple as going to eat
ramen, and try to
make every moment one that
she'll never
forget.
